title: Prompt NFT Tree
tagline: Prompt NFT Tree is a service that makes the prompt to be grown with everyone. Making NFT from AI prompts. Rewards are paid to developers each time the prompt is reused. Tracing the prompt's purchase history with blockchain technology makes us to watch the prompt's growth.
description:
This application was created with the goal of motivating prompt engineers.
Recently, generative AI has been making headlines, and at the same time, the number of "prompt engineers" who are able to generate good images with that generative AI has increased.
While prompts are hard to create, they are easy to imitate. And while it is certain that better imitations can be created, it is intolerable to have a prompt that one has spent a long time creating be copied for free.
We have created this "Prompt NFT Tree" in the hope that by using blockchain technology, we can solve the above problems and develop prompt engineering.

The prompt NFT tree is a service that grows prompts together, and NFTs are created from AI prompts. Each time a prompt is reused, the developer is rewarded. The prompt's purchase history can be traced through blockchain technology to watch the prompt grow.
In addition, the NFT is created with LIT encryption technology, which allows the prompt to be held more securely, so the prompt is not stored on-chain.
how_its_made:
This project uses Metamask. The network uses TAIKO, which is fast and inexpensive to create contracts. The front end uses svelte and the back end uses firebase. When storing the prompts in NFT, we encrypt them using the LIT protocol. This has allowed us to keep the prompts more securely. In addition, we use generativeAI to generate the images.
The use of TAIKO lowers the cost of gas for the NFT and lowers the barrier to participation for the general public. We were also able to easily port the Solidity code during development.
With LitProtocol, we can easily implement encryption with access control.Prompts encrypted with LIT Protocol are written to TAIKO's NFT.
